_comment: Auto-compaction policy, applied by the installer and checked by bin/pi-setup-doctor.
Both read this file so the rule lives in one place.
Pi checks contextTokens > contextWindow - reserveTokens at two points, both OUTSIDE a run:
before sending a new user prompt (agent-session.js:862) and after an agent run returns
(_handlePostAgentRun, :776). Nothing is checked inside a run. So the reserve's real job is
to guarantee that a run which starts just under the threshold still has room to finish.
It must therefore cover the token growth of one whole run plus room to generate a reply.
Sizing evidence, all measured on gpt-5.6-sol with a 272000-token window:
019fb8da (2026-07-31, reserve 16384): run crossed at 265232 and grew to 290536.
019fcaa8 (2026-08-04, reserve 45000): run STARTED at 214665, under the 227000 threshold,
so Pi correctly declined to compact first. It then grew 53324 tokens over 49 calls and
hit the window at 267989 with ~4000 left, so the model was truncated mid-reasoning
(stopReason length). 45000 was under the observed run growth of 53324 - that is what
made it reachable. 68000 would have compacted before that run ever started.
mk (2026-08-03, reserve 45000): one run reached ~328000, 120.5% of the window.
68000 is the 0.25-of-window cap for a 272000 window, and comfortably exceeds the largest
single-run growth actually observed (53324). It is still slack, not a bound: a long enough
run passes any threshold, as mk showed. No setting prevents that, and ctx.compact() cannot
help because it aborts the agent. Only ending the run lets Pi compact.
An earlier version of this note said no extension could bound within-run growth. That is
no longer true, and the distinction matters for this number. the fold half of pi-context-handoff shrinks
the REQUEST from the context hook (before each LLM call), so a long run stays inside the
window without Pi compacting. It does not shrink HISTORY - only Pi's own compaction, which
this reserve governs, does that. So 68000 stays as it is: it is sized for the case where
the fold does not happen, and the fold is explicitly allowed to fail into doing nothing.
Revisit toward Codex's ~27200 equivalent only once a production run has been carried past
245000 tokens by the fold rather than by a forced trigger.
See docs/LONG_RUNS.md.
maxFractionOfWindow keeps the reserve away from bin/pi-setup-doctor's upper guard (half
the window) on small-context models, where a flat 68000 would leave too little usable
context. minReserveTokens is Pi's own default, the floor this never goes below.
